message: With storm season upon us, I find myself reminiscing about the simpler days of hunkering down with a deck of cards and a flashlight. It’s a reminder that sometimes, the best way to ride out a storm is to embrace a little low-tech fun while preparing for the unexpected. If you're looking for some solid tips to feel a bit more ready, it’s worth checking out the info from a trusted source. Stay cozy and maybe plan a family game night! ☔️
